title: Abraham Lempel
name: Abraham Lempel
summary: Israeli computer scientist and information theorist who co-created the Lempel–Ziv family of lossless compression algorithms.
whyThisMatters: Lossless compression is core infrastructure for computing and communications. Lempel’s work, developed with Jacob Ziv, became a durable foundation for widely deployed digital formats and transmission systems.

sections.overview:
Israeli computer scientist and information theorist who co-created the Lempel–Ziv family of lossless compression algorithms.

Historical contribution

Lossless compression is core infrastructure for computing and communications. Lempel’s work, developed with Jacob Ziv, became a durable foundation for widely deployed digital formats and transmission systems.

In memoriam

Abraham Lempel died in 2023. This archive remembers their contribution with care and credits the historical record on which this account relies.

timeline.event: Completes his doctorate at the Technion.
Publishes the first Lempel–Ziv compression paper with Jacob Ziv.
